segments.text: I Beleeue in Chriſt dead, that is, I beleeue Chriſt, not onely to haue ſuffered extreame torments for my ſake, but alſo death it ſelfe, & hath by his death obtained for me remiſſion of ſinnes, and reconciliation with God, & conſequently alſo the holy Ghoſt, who beginneth in me a new life, that I may againe bee made the Temple of God, and at length attaine vnto euerlaſting life, wherein I ſhall woorſhip and magnifie God for euer.
